name: alternate high hop
display_role_basis: Source-informed artistic visible load proxies; cardiovascular system is not a surface muscle. Source target/secondary labels are retained, not rewritten; no measured activation claim.
source_instructions: Stand tall with your arms ready to swing.
Hop off one foot and drive the opposite knee up.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Switch legs on the next hop.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your legs.

phases.label: Four alternating spring hops with declared ground/flight phases

interpretation: Authored slowed five-second demonstration, not a claimed source tempo or clinical/force/stability certification. Four one-foot spring hops with opposite knee drive, 0.30-second ballistic flight per hop, toe push-off and ball landing; knee/ankle flexion and opposing arm swing absorb/prepare each contact.
